verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents multiple well-specified public APIs (Track, Pipelines, App API, Transactional API) with a live OpenAPI spec and Postman collection, plus AI-specific tooling (CLI, MCP server) explicitly built for driving the product programmatically. This is strong first-party documentation with a verified live OpenAPI endpoint, though independent hands-on corroboration of API usage specifically (vs. general product complaints) is limited. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of API completeness or reliability beyond vendor docs.
